state.objective: Challenge a conservative payroll and expense compression candidate and determine the next COA domain to review.
confirmed_facts: There are two parallel legacy payroll sets with the same 13 component labels, total 26 families. The meaning of the two prefixes is unknown.
Round 1 conditionally supported 26 to 13 only if the duplicate axis is a reliable department/function dimension, and rejected collapsing all components into one payroll GL.
There are ten maintenance-related families. One is Software Maintenance. Nine relate to physical FFE/computer/building/staff house/vehicle/AC-refrigerator/power plant/painting/lift objects.
Round 1 conditionally supported fewer maintenance GLs using asset_class/work_order, but required separate review of Software Maintenance.
There are 36 Replacement OE expense families named only by replaced OE item type. Their expense-versus-capitalization and reserve posting mechanism remain unresolved.
Round 1 rejected indiscriminate combination of utilities, vehicle costs, bank charges, miscellaneous and leases.
No management P&L, payroll/statutory mapping, tax treatment, capitalization policy, postings or balances have been supplied.

candidate_mapping.payroll: 26 to 13 natural payroll components, only after confirming the duplicate legacy prefix is function/department and dimensions reproduce existing reports.
candidate_mapping.maintenance: Keep Software Maintenance provisional; conditionally reduce nine physical-object maintenance accounts to one Repairs & Maintenance GL with asset_class/work_order detail if policy/reporting align.
candidate_mapping.replacement_oe: Conditionally reduce 36 named Replacement OE expense accounts to one Replacement OE Expense GL with item_class/asset/work_order detail only after expense-versus-capitalization and reserve mechanics are resolved.
candidate_mapping.other_expenses: No compression proposed from names alone.

candidate_quality.instructions: How should the candidate mapping be treated?

criteria.conditional: A defensible hypothesis with explicit client-evidence gates.
criteria.approve_now: Final mapping can be approved from names.
criteria.invalid: Dimensional compression is inherently invalid for all three candidates.

payroll_thirteen.instructions: Given missing statutory and management mappings, is retaining 13 distinct payroll components after removing the duplicate function axis safer than reducing them further now?

criteria.yes: Use 13 provisionally; later combine only when accounting, tax, accrual and reporting treatment match.
criteria.twenty_six: Keep both duplicate sets even if dimensions fully reproduce the axis.

payroll_dimension_controls.instructions: What must replace the lost payroll prefix if 26 become 13?

criteria.function_costcenter: Mandatory function/cost_center derived from employee assignment and payroll run, with reconciliation to the old reporting axis.

physical_maintenance_nine_to_one.instructions: If the nine physical-object maintenance families share expense recognition and reporting can be reproduced by asset_class/work_order, is nine to one reasonable?

criteria.conditional: Yes, with capitalization controls and dimension reconciliation.
criteria.retain_nine: Object identity must remain in GL.

software_separate_provisional.instructions: Is keeping Software Maintenance separate provisionally reasonable while checking subscriptions, implementation work and capitalization?

criteria.yes: Keep separate until service/capitalization treatment is understood.

replacement_thirty_six_to_one.instructions: If transaction testing proves all 36 Replacement OE accounts are the same expense nature and item names only identify the replaced object, is 36 to one reasonable?

criteria.conditional: Yes, use item_class/asset_id/work_order for object detail.
criteria.retain_36: Every object type must remain a GL.
criteria.reserve: Merge automatically with the balance-sheet Reserve Replacement OE accounts.

reserve_expense_separation.instructions: Even if both 36-account sets are compressed, must balance-sheet Reserve Replacement OE and Replacement OE Expense remain separate accounting natures?

criteria.yes: Keep reserve/contra/provision balance separately from expense and link through policy/subledger.
criteria.combine: Use one GL for both balance-sheet and expense balances.

capitalization_control.instructions: What control is needed when entering repair or replacement costs?

criteria.rule_workflow: Policy-based expense-versus-capitalize decision using amount, useful-life enhancement, replacement component and asset/work-order evidence.
criteria.account_name: Choose solely from the legacy account label.

expense_type_dimension.instructions: Should expense_type be allowed to replace every natural expense account?

criteria.no: Use it for operational detail beneath meaningful natural expense natures, not to erase all distinctions.
criteria.yes: Use one operating-expense GL with expense_type for everything.
criteria.optional: Allow users to omit both nature and type.

safe_now.instructions: What can be approved before client evidence?

criteria.architecture: Approve payroll component, cost center/function, asset/work-order dimensions and candidate mappings; keep GL reductions conditional.

next_domain.instructions: Which client COA pattern should be reviewed next after bank, assets, inventory and the expense candidates?

criteria.interunit_cleanup: Review the 70 legacy interunit-party families against the confirmed HO-unit-only centralized model, without creating a general counter_site dimension.
criteria.tax_accrual: Review tax/prepaid/accrual identities and schedules next.
criteria.ar_ap_party: Review customer/supplier identity in receivable and payable accounts next.

evidence_limit.instructions: Can repeated Jev agreement finalize these mappings without client reports, policy and transaction evidence?

criteria.no: Use Jev to define hypotheses and evidence gates only.
